definition_en: A planned set of activities to reach a goal, such as selling a product.
example_en_1: The summer campaign brought in many new customers.

definition_en: A talk in which someone shows and explains something to a group.
example_en_1: She gave a presentation about the new product.

definition_en: A large formal meeting where people discuss a subject.
example_en_1: The conference takes place in Ho Chi Minh City.

definition_en: One section of a large company.
example_en_1: He works in the sales department.

definition_en: The main office of a company.
example_en_1: The headquarters is in Hanoi.

definition_en: One of the shops or offices of a large company.
example_en_1: The bank opened a new branch near my house.

definition_en: A building where goods are made by machines.
example_en_1: The factory produces ten thousand shirts a day.

definition_en: All the people who work for an organization.
example_en_1: The staff are very friendly.

definition_en: Knowledge and skill you get from doing a job.
example_en_1: Do you have any experience in sales?

definition_en: The jobs a person does during their working life.
example_en_1: She started her career as a teacher.

definition_en: A decision or arrangement accepted by two or more sides.
example_en_1: The two companies reached an agreement.

definition_en: A business arrangement that two sides agree on.
example_en_1: We closed the deal on Friday.

definition_en: The need or wish of people to buy goods or services.
example_en_1: There is a high demand for electric bikes.

definition_en: Money spent on something.
example_en_1: Travel is our biggest expense.

definition_en: Money that you earn from work or investments.
example_en_1: Their income is enough for a family of four.

definition_en: Money paid each hour, day or week for work.
example_en_1: The minimum wage rose this year.

definition_en: The system of trade and industry in a country.
example_en_1: The economy grew by six percent last year.

definition_en: The businesses that make one kind of product or give one kind of service.
example_en_1: Tourism is an important industry in Vietnam.

definition_en: A business or company, often a small one.
example_en_1: He works for a law firm.

definition_en: To discuss something formally in order to reach an agreement.
example_en_1: After three long weeks of meetings, phone calls and emails, our small family company finally managed to negotiate a better price with its main supplier, which means that we can keep prices low for loyal customers and still pay every member of staff a fair bonus at the end of the year.

definition_en: To give someone a job.
example_en_1: We plan to hire two new designers.

definition_en: To pay someone to work for you.
example_en_1: The hotel employs about forty people.

definition_en: To officially leave your job.
example_en_1: She resigned to start her own business.

definition_en: To stop working, usually because of your age.
example_en_1: My father retired last year.

definition_en: To put money into a business so that you can make a profit.
example_en_1: They invested all their savings in the shop.

definition_en: To get money for the work you do.
example_en_1: How much do you earn a month?

definition_en: To have to pay money back to someone.
example_en_1: I still owe the bank a lot of money.

definition_en: To give money to someone who will pay it back later.
example_en_1: The bank agreed to lend us the money.

definition_en: To have enough money to pay for something.
example_en_1: We can't afford a new car this year.

definition_en: To ask an amount of money for goods or a service.
example_en_1: They charge extra for delivery.

definition_en: To take goods to the person who bought them.
example_en_1: We deliver to all districts of the city.

definition_en: To sell goods to another country.
example_en_1: Vietnam exports a lot of coffee.

definition_en: To buy goods from another country and bring them in.
example_en_1: We import machines from Japan.

definition_en: To make goods in large numbers in a factory.
example_en_1: The company manufactures shoes for sports brands.

definition_en: To make or grow something to sell.
example_en_1: This farm produces fruit for local markets.

definition_en: To tell people about a product so that they buy it.
example_en_1: We advertise on social media.

definition_en: To help sell a product by advertising it or making it popular.
example_en_1: Famous singers promote the new drink.

definition_en: To make a new product available for sale for the first time.
example_en_1: The company will launch its new phone in June.

definition_en: To be in charge of a business, team or project.
example_en_1: She manages a team of ten people.

definition_en: To plan and arrange an event or activity.
example_en_1: Who will organize the year-end party?

definition_en: To decide that something planned will not happen.
example_en_1: We had to cancel the meeting.

definition_en: To move an event to a later time.
example_en_1: The launch was postponed until next month.

definition_en: To go to an event such as a meeting or class.
example_en_1: All managers must attend the training.

definition_en: To ask formally for a job, usually in writing.
example_en_1: I applied for a job at a bank.

definition_en: To write your name on a document to show that you agree with it.
example_en_1: Please sign the form at the bottom.

definition_en: To officially accept a plan or request.
example_en_1: The director approved the budget.

definition_en: To refuse to accept an offer, plan or request.
example_en_1: They rejected our first offer.

definition_en: To say that someone or something is good or suitable.
example_en_1: Can you recommend a good accountant?

definition_en: To try to be more successful than other companies.
example_en_1: Small shops cannot compete with big supermarkets on price.

definition_en: To provide goods to a person or company.
example_en_1: A local farm supplies all our vegetables.

definition_en: To teach someone the skills they need for a job.
example_en_1: We train every new worker for two weeks.

definition_en: To succeed in reaching a goal.
example_en_1: We achieved all our goals this year.

definition_en: To become or make something larger in amount.
example_en_1: Sales increased by twenty percent.

definition_en: To make something smaller in amount or size.
example_en_1: We need to reduce our costs.

definition_en: To become larger, or to make a business larger.
example_en_1: The company plans to expand into Thailand.

definition_en: To guess a number or cost by using the information you have.
example_en_1: We estimate that the project will cost two billion dong.

definition_en: To make someone agree to do something by giving reasons.
example_en_1: She persuaded the client to sign the contract.

definition_en: To say that something is true or will happen as planned.
example_en_1: Please confirm your order by email.

definition_en: Making money.
example_en_1: The new branch is already profitable.

definition_en: Showing the skill and good behaviour expected at work.
example_en_1: The staff were very professional.

definition_en: Working well without wasting time or money.
example_en_1: The new system is more efficient.

definition_en: Good enough to compete well with others, especially on price.
example_en_1: Our prices are very competitive.

definition_en: Connected with money.
example_en_1: The company had financial problems last year.

definition_en: Happening once every year.
example_en_1: The annual meeting is in March.

definition_en: Needing to be done or dealt with immediately.
example_en_1: I have an urgent message for the manager.

definition_en: Able to be trusted to work well or do what is expected.
example_en_1: We need a reliable supplier.

gloss_vi: đủ trình độ, đủ tiêu chuẩn
definition_en: Having the right training or exams for a job.
example_en_1: We are looking for a qualified accountant.
